integrity: The structural criterion is proved directly from the two-part characterization of total domination in complete multipartite graphs and independently checked against the definition on bounded orders.
scientific_limitations: The all-set classification and enumerator are restricted to connected complete multipartite graphs.
The earlier cograph algorithm already gives broader algorithmic access to the minimum secure total domination number.
Finite verification through order ten is corroborative only.
Search coverage cannot exclude differently phrased or non-indexed enumerative work.
title: All secure total dominating sets of complete multipartite graphs
